name: Beuda (Spain)
description: Light green field charged at the centre with the red cross potent of the arms edged in yellow.
history: The council resolved to open the adoption file on 27 March 2008; the flag was approved on 14 April 2010 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5620 of 3 May 2011. It is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, light green, with the red Greek cross potent of the arms, its arms 1/13 of the height thick and 10/13 high, outlined yellow.

features.role: Greek cross potent of the arms edged yellow, 10/13 of the height
